text:
elaine: Heads up — multiple customer tickets where users sign in via Okta SAML but their RBAC roles are empty after first login. Happens intermittently (10-15% of logins).
sam: I reproduced on staging. JIT user record created but role_id is NULL. If user logs out/in again roles appear.
jordan: grabbing logs now. see this stack: 
```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z auth-proxy[pid=23]: SAML Assertion processed for uid=alice@example.com
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z jit-provisioner[pid=7]: creating user row id=3421
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z role-enricher[pid=12]: fetch attrs from idp -> OK
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z role-enricher[pid=12]: KMS decrypt failed: context mismatch, err=decryption error
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z role-enricher[pid=12]: enqueue role assignment job job_id=gh-881
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z web[pid=45]: session created for uid=alice@example.com -> session hits web-01 (no roles)
2026-03-18T14:02:12Z background-worker[pid=88]: job gh-881 started, writes role_id=5 to users.id=3421
```
jordan: note KMS decrypt error above, but the job later succeeds. race window where session is returned before job finishes.
security-bot: alert: 5 failed role-enrichment KMS decrypts in last 1h across prod region-us-east-1 :scream:
oncall: can we confirm if session affinity is misconfigured? If users are shuttled to different web instances they might hit cache without role refresh.
sam: checked LB sticky cookie config — looks fine. however our session creation path responds to the login request before background role job finishes. web returns app session with roles pulled from DB at time of session creation (NULL).
db-ops: DB write for role assignment is happening in a separate transactional context post-create. We also have eventual consistency on replicas; some web nodes read from read-replica lagging ~200ms. Combined with async job timing, that's the likely cause.
elaine: so two contributing factors: async enrichment job + replica lag. Also KMS decrypt intermittents (context mismatch) are spiking and delaying job start.
jordan: repro steps:
1) Force KMS mock to delay 300ms (`TEST_KMS_DELAY=300`).
2) Login via SAML.
3) Inspect `users` row immediately after SAML response.
4) Observe role_id NULL, session w/out role.

sam: quick mitigation idea: make initial session creation set role to "pending" and treat pending as minimal access (no admin). Then have role-enricher mutate to final role once job completes and trigger session refresh.
security-bot: note: setting default to "viewer" could be risky if some tenants rely on default elevated perms.
elaine: agreed — we must NOT fall back to admin. "pending" safer. Also need audit event emitted on user create and on role assignment (two events) so we can trace. Right now audit events are missing when enrichment fails.
db-ops: long-term fixes:
- Make role assignment synchronous in the auth path (cost: slight latency).
- OR guarantee read-after-write by forcing web to read from primary for fresh user rows.
- OR write initial role into users row within same create transaction if attrs available.

oncall: short-term hotfixs:
- Patch web to check role on first request and if NULL, block session return until role job completes OR refresh from primary with retry backoff (<=500ms total).
- Add instrumentation: counter for "session_created_with_null_role" and trace id in audit.
- KMS: put a retry/backoff on decrypt errors and surface metrics to security team.

jordan: also found audit-buffer sidecar was dropping some events when role-enricher crashed briefly. We'll add a disk-backed queue to sidecar.

sam: I pushed a staging change that makes auth wait up to 400ms for background job result (non-blocking) and it reduces incidence to ~1%. Behavior looks good.

elaine: action items:
- sam: land auth-side small wait + metrics by EOD (PR #1234).
- db-ops: evaluate forcing read-from-primary for initial user reads, report recommendations by tomorrow morning.
- jordan: add disk-backed queue for audit sidecar, open PR.
- security: investigate KMS context mismatch - could be key alias inconsistent across deploys.

oncall: I'll draft an internal incident note for the affected customers and mark as "low-sev but user-impacting" until fixes in prod.

security-bot: tagged incident-12345 for tracking.

elaine: thanks team — let's avoid shortcuts that give default elevated roles. Keep me posted in this thread. :thumbsup:
